meta_authority_example.caveat: Attacker's ability to trigger a meta-rule is an explicit model premise, not evidence it can persuade a real human.

meta_rule_exhaustive_crosscheck.checks: Typed gate-enable fixed point matches explicit BFS reachability for all cases.

nonmonotone_false_positive.reason: Nonduplicable source right a is consumed after first transfer. Use explicit state game, not monotone grants.

safety_vs_liveness_construction.qualification: An explicitly adversarial one-way tool interface; different service action can restore liveness.

limits: All meta rules are from a finite catalog; no unlisted new physical rule
Only monotone persistent grants compile to simple fixed point
Meta-veto honest root h is protected by assumption, not proven physically or politically
A trivial deny-all design is safety only, not viable coexistence
